sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as goals FROM (SELECT s.event_id FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'France') AND s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period != 5 UNION ALL SELECT event_id FROM sb.events WHERE team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'France') AND type = 'Own Goal For' AND period != 5) as all_goals;
reponse: Compte les buts marqués par la France, y compris les buts contre son camp, hors séance de tirs au but.

sql: WITH buteurs_par_equipe AS (SELECT e.team_id, t.team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.player_id) as n_buteurs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period != 5 GROUP BY e.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, n_buteurs FROM buteurs_par_equipe WHERE n_buteurs = (SELECT MAX(n_buteurs) FROM buteurs_par_equipe);
reponse: Retourne l'équipe ayant le plus de buteurs différents au tournoi.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as passes_reussies FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE pl.player_name ILIKE '%Modric%' AND p.outcome IS NULL AND e.period != 5;
reponse: Compte les passes réussies de Luka Modric hors séance de tirs au but.

sql: SELECT AVG(duration_seconds) as avg_duration FROM sb.possessions WHERE period != 5;
reponse: Calcule la durée moyenne des possessions en secondes, excluant la séance de tirs au but.
La base ne contient pas l'âge des joueurs, information nécessaire pour calculer l'âge moyen des buteurs.
La base ne contient pas d'information sur l'assistance ou le nombre de spectateurs pour les matchs.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as remplacements FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Substitution' AND period != 5;
reponse: Compte le nombre total de remplacements effectués, hors séance de tirs au but.

sql: WITH corners_par_equipe AS (SELECT e.team_id, t.team_name, COUNT(*) as n_corners FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE p.pass_type = 'Corner' AND e.period != 5 GROUP BY e.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, n_corners FROM corners_par_equipe WHERE n_corners = (SELECT MAX(n_corners) FROM corners_par_equipe);
reponse: Retourne l'équipe ayant tenté le plus de corners au tournoi.

sql: WITH stats_possessions AS (SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) as total_possessions, COUNT(CASE WHEN reached_final_third = true THEN 1 END) as final_third_count, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN reached_final_third = true THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) as proportion FROM sb.possessions WHERE period != 5 GROUP BY team_id) SELECT t.team_name, proportion FROM stats_possessions s JOIN sb.teams t ON s.team_id = t.team_id WHERE proportion = (SELECT MAX(proportion) FROM stats_possessions);
reponse: Retourne l'équipe atteignant le dernier tiers adverse sur la plus grande proportion de ses possessions.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as fautes FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Foul Committed' AND team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Uruguay') AND period != 5;
reponse: Compte le nombre de fautes commises par l'Uruguay, hors séance de tirs au but.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as buts_contre_camp FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Own Goal Against' AND period != 5;
reponse: Compte le nombre total de buts contre son camp marqués durant le tournoi.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.player_id) as n_buteurs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period != 5;
reponse: Compte le nombre de joueurs différents ayant marqué au moins un but au tournoi.

sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.outcome IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) as taux_passes_reussies FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Spain') AND e.period != 5;
reponse: Calcule le taux de passes réussies de l'Espagne (passes réussies / total passes).

sql: WITH matches_par_arbitre AS (SELECT referee, COUNT(*) as n_matchs FROM sb.matches GROUP BY referee) SELECT referee, n_matchs FROM matches_par_arbitre WHERE n_matchs = (SELECT MAX(n_matchs) FROM matches_par_arbitre);
reponse: Retourne l'arbitre ayant dirigé le plus de matchs du tournoi.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n_centres FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'England') AND p.is_cross = true AND e.period != 5;
reponse: Compte le nombre de centres tentés par l'Angleterre, hors séance de tirs au but.
La base ne contient pas l'information du club des joueurs pendant la Coupe du monde.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as cartons_jaunes FROM sb.events WHERE ((type = 'Foul Committed' AND details -> 'foul_committed' -> 'card' ->> 'name' = 'Yellow Card') OR (type = 'Bad Behaviour' AND details -> 'bad_behaviour' -> 'card' ->> 'name' = 'Yellow Card')) AND period != 5;
reponse: Compte le nombre total de cartons jaunes distribués au tournoi, hors séance de tirs au but.

sql: SELECT stadium FROM sb.matches WHERE stage = 'Final';
reponse: Retourne le stade où s'est jouée la finale du tournoi.

sql: WITH tirs_hors_surface AS (SELECT e.team_id, t.team_name, COUNT(*) as n_tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE NOT (e.loc_x >= 102 AND e.loc_y >= 18 AND e.loc_y <= 62) AND e.period != 5 GROUP BY e.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, n_tirs FROM tirs_hors_surface WHERE n_tirs = (SELECT MAX(n_tirs) FROM tirs_hors_surface);
reponse: Retourne l'équipe ayant tenté le plus de tirs hors de la surface de réparation.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as matchs_nuls FROM sb.matches WHERE home_score = away_score;
reponse: Compte le nombre de matchs se terminant sur un match nul.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n_matchs FROM sb.matches;
reponse: Compte le nombre total de matchs disputés au tournoi.

sql: WITH matches_with_penalties AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.match_id, m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id FROM sb.matches m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sb.events e WHERE e.match_id = m.match_id AND e.period = 5)), goals_in_penalties AS (SELECT e.match_id, e.team_id, COUNT(*) as penalty_goals FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.shots s ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.period = 5 AND s.outcome = 'Goal' GROUP BY e.match_id, e.team_id), winners AS (SELECT match_id, team_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY penalty_goals DESC) as rk FROM goals_in_penalties) SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) as penalty_wins FROM winners w JOIN sb.teams t ON w.team_id = t.team_id WHERE w.rk = 1 GROUP BY w.team_id, t.team_name ORDER BY penalty_wins DESC;
reponse: Retourne les équipes ayant remporté au moins une séance de tirs au but et le nombre de séances remportées.

sql: WITH assists_par_joueur AS (SELECT e.player_id, pl.player_name, COUNT(*) as n_assists FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE p.goal_assist = true AND e.period != 5 GROUP BY e.player_id, pl.player_name) SELECT player_name, n_assists FROM assists_par_joueur WHERE n_assists = (SELECT MAX(n_assists) FROM assists_par_joueur);
reponse: Retourne le joueur ayant délivré le plus de passes décisives au tournoi.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as assists FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE pl.player_name ILIKE '%Hazard%' AND p.goal_assist = true AND e.period != 5;
reponse: Compte le nombre de passes décisives délivrées par Eden Hazard, hors séance de tirs au but.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n_tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Croatia') AND e.period != 5;
reponse: Compte le nombre total de tirs tentés par la Croatie, hors séance de tirs au but.

sql: WITH earliest_goal_time AS (SELECT MIN(COALESCE(e.match_seconds, e.minute * 60 + e.second)) as min_time FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period != 5) SELECT pl.player_name, e.minute, e.second FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id CROSS JOIN earliest_goal_time WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period != 5 AND COALESCE(e.match_seconds, e.minute * 60 + e.second) = earliest_goal_time.min_time;
reponse: Retourne le joueur ayant marqué le but le plus rapide depuis le coup d'envoi au tournoi.

sql: WITH possession_totale AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(duration_seconds) as total_duration FROM sb.possessions WHERE period != 5 GROUP BY team_id) SELECT t.team_name, p.total_duration FROM possession_totale p JOIN sb.teams t ON p.team_id = t.team_id WHERE p.total_duration = (SELECT MAX(total_duration) FROM possession_totale);
interpretation: Possession mesurée par la durée totale en secondes des possessions (plutôt que par pourcentage de passes).
reponse: Retourne l'équipe ayant eu le plus de temps de possession.

sql: WITH xg_par_equipe AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(sum_xg) as total_xg FROM sb.possessions WHERE period != 5 GROUP BY team_id) SELECT t.team_name, x.total_xg FROM xg_par_equipe x JOIN sb.teams t ON x.team_id = t.team_id WHERE x.total_xg = (SELECT MAX(total_xg) FROM xg_par_equipe);
reponse: Retourne l'équipe ayant cumulé le plus d'expected goals (xG) au tournoi.

sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.outcome IN ('Goal', 'Saved') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) as pourcentage_cadre FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'France') AND e.period != 5;
reponse: Calcule le pourcentage de tirs cadrés de la France (buts + tirs arrêtés / total tirs).

sql: WITH dribbles_par_joueur AS (SELECT e.player_id, pl.player_name, COUNT(*) as n_dribbles FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE e.type = 'Dribble' AND e.details -> 'dribble' -> 'outcome' ->> 'name' = 'Complete' AND e.period != 5 GROUP BY e.player_id, pl.player_name) SELECT player_name, n_dribbles FROM dribbles_par_joueur WHERE n_dribbles = (SELECT MAX(n_dribbles) FROM dribbles_par_joueur);
reponse: Retourne le joueur ayant réussi le plus de dribbles au tournoi.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n_tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.matches m ON e.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage = 'Final' AND e.period != 5;
reponse: Compte le nombre de tirs tentés lors de la finale, hors séance de tirs au but.

sql: SELECT m.match_date, t1.team_name as home_team, t2.team_name as away_team, m.home_score, m.away_score, m.home_score + m.away_score as total_goals FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams t1 ON m.home_team_id = t1.team_id JOIN sb.teams t2 ON m.away_team_id = t2.team_id WHERE m.home_score + m.away_score = (SELECT MAX(home_score + away_score) FROM sb.matches);
reponse: Retourne le match avec le plus grand nombre total de buts marqués.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as penalties_marques FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.shot_type = 'Penalty' AND s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period != 5;
reponse: Compte le nombre de penalties transformés en cours de match, excluant la séance de tirs au but.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as goals_in_extra_time FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period = 2 AND e.minute >= 90;
reponse: Compte le nombre de buts marqués dans le temps additionnel de la seconde période.

sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) as goal_assists FROM sb.passes pa JOIN sb.events e ON pa.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name ILIKE '%Hazard%' AND pa.goal_assist = true AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY goal_assists DESC
reponse: Requête compte les passes décisives (goal_assist=true) d'Hazard, hors séance de tirs au but.

sql: WITH ranked_shots AS (SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) as shots_on_target FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id WHERE s.outcome IN ('Goal', 'Saved') AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name) SELECT player_name, shots_on_target FROM ranked_shots WHERE shots_on_target = (SELECT MAX(shots_on_target) FROM ranked_shots) ORDER BY player_name
reponse: Requête compte les tirs cadrés (outcome='Goal' ou 'Saved') par joueur et retourne le(s) joueur(s) avec le maximum.

sql: WITH goals AS (SELECT e.player_id, p.player_name, COUNT(*) as goals FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY e.player_id, p.player_name) SELECT player_name, goals FROM goals WHERE goals = (SELECT MAX(goals) FROM goals) ORDER BY player_name
reponse: Requête compte les buts marqués (outcome='Goal') par joueur, hors tirs au but, et retourne le(s) meilleur(s) buteur(s).

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as through_balls_completed FROM sb.passes WHERE technique = 'Through Ball' AND outcome IS NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sb.events e WHERE e.event_id = sb.passes.event_id AND e.period < 5) > 0
interpretation: Interprétation : 'passe en profondeur' = Through Ball réussie (outcome IS NULL), hors tirs au but.
reponse: Requête compte les passes de type 'Through Ball' réussies, en interprétant 'passe en profondeur' comme une passe de type Through Ball.
Hors périmètre : la base ne contient pas de note ou évaluation subjective du 'meilleur joueur'. Seules des statistiques objectives sont disponibles (buts, passes, xG, etc.).

sql: WITH croatia_id AS (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Croatia') SELECT COUNT(*) as matches_played FROM sb.matches WHERE home_team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM croatia_id) OR away_team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM croatia_id)
reponse: Requête compte tous les matchs joués par la Croatie en phase de groupes et en phases finales (home ou away).

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as goals_from_free_kick FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.play_pattern = 'From Free Kick' AND e.period < 5
interpretation: Interprétation : buts marqués à partir d'une action initiée par coup franc (play_pattern='From Free Kick'), pas nécessairement directs.
reponse: Requête compte les tirs marqués (outcome='Goal') joués après un coup franc, hors tirs au but.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as goals_with_head FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND s.body_part = 'Head' AND e.period < 5
reponse: Requête compte les tirs marqués de la tête (body_part='Head' et outcome='Goal'), hors tirs au but.

sql: WITH group_stage_teams AS (SELECT DISTINCT home_team_id as team_id FROM sb.matches WHERE stage = 'Group Stage' UNION SELECT DISTINCT away_team_id as team_id FROM sb.matches WHERE stage = 'Group Stage'), team_records AS (SELECT t.team_id, SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_id = t.team_id AND m.home_score > m.away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_id = t.team_id AND m.away_score > m.home_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins FROM group_stage_teams t LEFT JOIN sb.matches m ON (m.home_team_id = t.team_id OR m.away_team_id = t.team_id) AND m.stage = 'Group Stage' GROUP BY t.team_id) SELECT COUNT(*) as teams_with_no_wins FROM team_records WHERE wins = 0
reponse: Requête compte les équipes de phase de groupes avec zéro victoires.

sql: WITH team_goals_conceded AS (SELECT m.home_team_id as team_id, SUM(m.away_score) as goals_conceded FROM sb.matches m GROUP BY m.home_team_id UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_id as team_id, SUM(m.home_score) as goals_conceded FROM sb.matches m GROUP BY m.away_team_id), total_goals_conceded AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(goals_conceded) as total_conceded FROM team_goals_conceded GROUP BY team_id) SELECT t.team_name, tgc.total_conceded FROM total_goals_conceded tgc JOIN sb.teams t ON tgc.team_id = t.team_id WHERE tgc.total_conceded = (SELECT MAX(total_conceded) FROM total_goals_conceded)
reponse: Requête totalise les buts encaissés par chaque équipe et retourne celle(s) avec le maximum.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as shots_attempted FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name ILIKE '%Mbapp%' AND e.period < 5
reponse: Requête compte tous les tirs tentés par Kylian Mbappé (recherche par ILIKE), hors tirs au but.

sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(s.statsbomb_xg) as total_xg FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id WHERE e.period < 5 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_xg DESC LIMIT 5
reponse: Requête agrège l'xG par joueur et retourne les 5 premiers, du plus élevé au plus faible, hors tirs au but.
Hors périmètre : les données concernent uniquement la Coupe du monde 2018. Aucune donnée disponible pour 2022.

sql: WITH pass_stats AS (SELECT e.team_id, t.team_name, COUNT(*) as total_passes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.outcome IS NULL) as completed_passes FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE e.period < 5 GROUP BY e.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, (completed_passes::numeric / total_passes) as completion_rate FROM pass_stats WHERE (completed_passes::numeric / total_passes) = (SELECT MAX(completed_passes::numeric / total_passes) FROM pass_stats)
reponse: Requête calcule le taux de passes réussies (outcome IS NULL) par équipe, hors tirs au but, et retourne la(les) meilleure(s).

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as possessions_with_shot FROM sb.possessions WHERE team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Belgium') AND produced_shot = true
reponse: Requête compte les possessions de la Belgique qui ont produit un tir (produced_shot=true).

sql: SELECT SUM(home_score) + SUM(away_score) as total_goals FROM sb.matches
reponse: Requête totalise tous les buts du tournoi via les scores des matchs (qui comptent les prolongations et excluent les tirs au but par définition).

sql: WITH goals_by_period AS (SELECT e.period, COUNT(*) as goals FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY e.period), total_goals AS (SELECT SUM(goals) as total FROM goals_by_period) SELECT (SELECT goals FROM goals_by_period WHERE period = 1)::numeric / (SELECT total FROM total_goals) as first_half_ratio
reponse: Requête calcule la proportion de buts marqués en première période (period=1) par rapport au total, hors tirs au but.
Hors périmètre : la base ne contient pas de colonne de distance totale parcourue. Les coordonnées (loc_x, loc_y) sont disponibles, mais pas la distance cumulée par joueur.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as goals_in_extra_time FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period IN (3, 4)
reponse: Requête compte les tirs marqués en prolongations (period=3 ou 4).

sql: WITH pass_stats AS (SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) as completed_passes FROM sb.passes pa JOIN sb.events e ON pa.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id WHERE pa.outcome IS NULL AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name) SELECT player_name, completed_passes FROM pass_stats WHERE completed_passes = (SELECT MAX(completed_passes) FROM pass_stats) ORDER BY player_name
reponse: Requête compte les passes réussies (outcome IS NULL) par joueur et retourne le(s) joueur(s) avec le maximum, hors tirs au but.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sb.matches) as avg_shots_per_match FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.period < 5
reponse: Requête calcule la moyenne de tirs par match en divisant le nombre total de tirs par le nombre de matchs, hors tirs au but.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id WHERE (e.type = 'Foul Committed' AND e.details -> 'foul_committed' -> 'card' ->> 'name' IN ('Red Card', 'Second Yellow')) OR (e.type = 'Bad Behaviour' AND e.details -> 'bad_behaviour' -> 'card' ->> 'name' = 'Red Card') ORDER BY p.player_name
reponse: Requête extrait les joueurs avec carton rouge ou deuxième avertissement du jsonb (types 'Foul Committed' et 'Bad Behaviour').

sql: WITH goal_xg AS (SELECT p.player_name, s.statsbomb_xg FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period < 5) SELECT player_name, statsbomb_xg FROM goal_xg WHERE statsbomb_xg = (SELECT MIN(statsbomb_xg) FROM goal_xg) ORDER BY player_name
reponse: Requête retourne le(s) but(s) marqué(s) avec le plus faible xG (le plus improbable), hors tirs au but.

sql: WITH team_fouls AS (SELECT e.team_id, t.team_name, COUNT(*) as total_fouls, COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) as matches FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.matches m ON e.match_id = m.match_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE e.type = 'Foul Committed' AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY e.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, (total_fouls::numeric / matches) as fouls_per_match FROM team_fouls WHERE (total_fouls::numeric / matches) = (SELECT MAX(total_fouls::numeric / matches) FROM team_fouls)
reponse: Requête calcule les fautes par match pour chaque équipe et retourne la(les) plus pénalisée(s), hors tirs au but.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) as matches_decided_by_penalties FROM sb.matches m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sb.events e WHERE e.match_id = m.match_id AND e.period = 5)
reponse: Requête compte les matchs ayant des événements en period=5, ce qui indique une séance de tirs au but.
Hors périmètre : la base ne contient pas de colonne de vitesse des tirs. Seul le xG, les coordonnées de fin et le résultat du tir sont disponibles.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as penalties_in_regular_time FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.shot_type = 'Penalty' AND e.period < 5
reponse: Requête compte les pénalités tirées (shot_type='Penalty') en temps régulier et prolongations, hors séance de tirs au but.

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN m.home_score > m.away_score THEN t1.team_name ELSE t2.team_name END as winner FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams t1 ON m.home_team_id = t1.team_id JOIN sb.teams t2 ON m.away_team_id = t2.team_id WHERE m.stage = 'Final'
reponse: Requête identifie le vainqueur de la finale en comparant les scores réguliers (home_score vs away_score).

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as matches_won FROM sb.matches m WHERE (m.home_team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Russia') AND m.home_score > m.away_score) OR (m.away_team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Russia') AND m.away_score > m.home_score)
reponse: Requête compte les matchs gagnés par la Russie en tant que home_team ou away_team.

sql: WITH team_goals_conceded AS (SELECT m.home_team_id as team_id, SUM(m.away_score) as goals_conceded FROM sb.matches m GROUP BY m.home_team_id UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_id as team_id, SUM(m.home_score) as goals_conceded FROM sb.matches m GROUP BY m.away_team_id), total_goals_conceded AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(goals_conceded) as total_conceded FROM team_goals_conceded GROUP BY team_id) SELECT t.team_name, tgc.total_conceded FROM total_goals_conceded tgc JOIN sb.teams t ON tgc.team_id = t.team_id WHERE tgc.total_conceded = (SELECT MIN(total_conceded) FROM total_goals_conceded)
reponse: Requête totalise les buts encaissés par chaque équipe et retourne la(les) équipe(s) avec le minimum (meilleure défense).

sql: WITH team_shots_conceded AS (SELECT m.home_team_id as defending_team_id, COUNT(*) as shots_conceded FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.matches m ON e.match_id = m.match_id WHERE e.team_id = m.away_team_id AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY m.home_team_id UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_id as defending_team_id, COUNT(*) as shots_conceded FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.matches m ON e.match_id = m.match_id WHERE e.team_id = m.home_team_id AND e.period < 5 GROUP BY m.away_team_id), total_shots_conceded AS (SELECT defending_team_id as team_id, SUM(shots_conceded) as total_conceded FROM team_shots_conceded GROUP BY defending_team_id) SELECT t.team_name, tsc.total_conceded FROM total_shots_conceded tsc JOIN sb.teams t ON tsc.team_id = t.team_id WHERE tsc.total_conceded = (SELECT MAX(total_conceded) FROM total_shots_conceded)
reponse: Requête compte les tirs encaissés par chaque équipe et retourne la(les) plus impactée(s), hors tirs au but.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ((jsonb_array_elements(e.details -> 'tactics' -> 'lineup')->'player'->>'id')::integer)) as unique_starters FROM sb.events e WHERE e.type = 'Starting XI' AND e.team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'France')
reponse: Requête extrait les IDs de joueurs uniques du jsonb 'lineup' dans les événements 'Starting XI' de la France.
